description: SvRadioGroup in Svelte 5 as a plan picker and a shipping-method selector with a disabled option. The group follows the WAI-ARIA radiogroup pattern with roving arrow-key focus, takes its choices from an options array, reports the value through onChange and supports a label and validation.

faq.question: How do options get their labels and values?
faq.answer: options is an array of { value, label } objects, optionally with disabled or a description. The group renders one radio per entry and reports the chosen value.

faq.question: How does keyboard focus move?
faq.answer: One radio is in the tab order at a time; arrow keys move selection and focus together, matching native radio behaviour.

faq.question: Can the radios be laid out horizontally?
faq.answer: Yes. orientation='horizontal' places them in a row; the default is a vertical list.
